candidate_evidence.quote: ex-vivo organoid cultures composed of tumor cells within their microenvironment (glioblastoma organoid - GBO) and intra- and peri-tumoral blood vessels (blood vessel organoid - BVO)

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: in patients with newly diagnosed glioblastoma

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Proportion (in number of patients) of phenotypically and molecularly exploitable tumor and vascular organoid models (GBO+BVO) seven days after diagnostic neurosurgical removal

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Correlation of organoid evolution under experimental treatment procedure and evolution of plasma-based biomarker from corresponding patients and along first-line treatment schedule.

agents.agent_name_registered: temozolomide (standard of care, not a registered intervention)

role_evidence.quote: All patients will be planned to receive standard of care for glioblastoma after resection, namely radiotherapy+temozolomide and TTFields.

coder_notes: Non-drug organoid feasibility study (phase NA). No therapeutic agent under test. Temozolomide listed because the text says all patients receive it.
